name: fabriciq
description: > Answer natural-language business questions over existing Power BI reports and semantic models through the FabricIQ MCP endpoint. Orchestrates artifact discovery, schema inspection, entity resolution, DAX generation, and query execution to return plain-language answers. Use when the user asks what, which, compare, rank, explain, or summarize questions about the data in a Power BI report or semantic model, including asking for a DAX query to be run against a named model. Triggers: "ask power bi"
author: microsoft
summary_zh: 通过自然语言查询现有 Power BI 报表和语义模型，自动生成并执行 DAX，适合数据对比、排名、解释和汇总分析。
